say:0:1623147001:1.text: The plants aren't heavily contaminated, but the risk is real: this could escalate into a larger, more dangerous mutation.
say:0:1623147001:1.source_cn: 经过检查，你发现植物所受的污染虽不严重，却有引发更大异...

say:1:1623147002:1.text: Stranger still, those odd mushrooms contain something that suppresses the toxins.
say:1:1623147002:1.source_cn: 而更令人惊讶的是，那种怪异蘑菇体内竟含有抑制毒性的成分。

say:2:1623147003:0.text: You decide to refine it into an antidote. This might be the key to reversing the damage.
say:2:1623147003:0.source_cn: 你决定果断尝试将其提炼成解药——这或许是让森林复原的关键。

document:3:541:0.text:
This potion is made using three corrupted fungi: <style="highlight">mooncaps, rotcaps, and dustbane</style>. First, dry the <style="highlight">mooncaps</style> and grind them into a fine powder. Then roast the <style="highlight">rotcaps</style> over a low flame to draw out their essence. Finally, mix everything with the liquid extracted from <style="highlight">dustbane</style> and let the blend crystallize on its own.

It's a highly specialized remedy, designed to neutralize corrupted matter and reverse mutation. If the forest is ever to return to what it once was, this potion is the key.
document:3:541:0.source_cn:
此解药以<style="highlight">“月光菇（污染）”“蚀心菇（污染）”“净尘菌（污染）”</style>为基材。先将<style="highlight">月光菇（污染）</style>阴干研磨成粉，再以<style="highlight">蚀心菇（污染）</style>的菌盖文火慢烤出精华，最后与<style="highlight">净尘菌（污染）</style>的菌液一同催化结晶。
药性专一，能有效中和污染物质，逆转变异过程，是使森林恢复原貌的关键制剂。
